item.title: Multi-Threading with Web Workers
item.description: We’ve repeated it several times throughout these notes: JavaScript is single-threaded. Normally, that’s fine. But what happens if you need to process a 50MB CSV file, apply image blur filters, or run heavy cryptographic hashing in the browser? If you run that loop on the main thread, the entire browser tab completely freezes. Buttons stop clicking, typing halts, and the dreaded “Page Unresponsive” popup appears. :') The solution? Offload heavy calculations onto genuine background threads using Web Workers.

item.title: Standard Library - Worker Threads
item.description: Halo semua, kembali lagi bersama Author :') Inilah catatan penutup untuk rangkaian seri pembelajaran NodeJS Standard Library kita! Salah satu kritik terbesar orang terhadap NodeJS di masa lalu adalah: “NodeJS itu single-threaded, ngga cocok buat komputasi berat (CPU-intensive task)!" Kalau ada perhitungan matematika jutaan iterasi, seluruh server bakal macet dan request user lain ngga bisa masuk. Tapi sejak kehadiran modul worker_threads, anggapan itu resmi dipatahkan! NodeJS sekarang memiliki dukungan resmi untuk komputasi paralel sejati memanfaatkan seluruh core prosesor di CPU kita.
